/*
Write a PL/SQL block that find 1 . Area Of Circle

3. Circumference of Circle */

SET SERVEROUTPUT ON SET FEEDBACK OFF
SET VERIFY OFF

DECLARE
PI CONSTANT NUMBER(3,2) := 3.14; R NUMBER(5);
CAREA NUMBER(7,2);

L NUMBER(5); W NUMBER(5);
RAREA NUMBER(7,2);

CIR NUMBER(7,2);

BEGIN
R:=&R;

L:=&L; W:=&W;

DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('1. Area of Circle'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('================='); CAREA:=PI*POWER(R,2);

BEGIN

3. Write a PL/SQL block which displays gross salary of employees as per user input EID. (Consider EMP table with EID, EName, Deptno, Deptname Gender, Age, BasicSal) with appropriate data types.) Gross_Salary: BASICSAL + (DA + HRA + Medical) -- PF. Rules: HRA = 15% of basic, DA = 50% of basic, Medical = Rs. 500, PF = 10% of basic.


/*
Write a PL/SQL block which displays gross salary of employees as per user input EID.

Gross Salary = BASIC SAL + DA + HRA + Medical - PF

Rules:
HRA= 15% of Basic Salary DA       = 50% of Basic Salary Medical = Rs. 500
PF= 10% of Basic Salary */

SET SERVEROUTPUT ON SET FEEDBACK OFF
SET VERIFY OFF

DECLARE
V_EIDEMP.EID%TYPE; V_ENAMEEMP.ENAME%TYPE; V_DEPTNO EMP.DEPTNO%TYPE;
V_DEPTNAME EMP.DEPTNAME%TYPE; V_GENDEREMP.GENDER%TYPE; V_AGEEMP.AGE%TYPE; V_BASICSAL EMP.BASICSAL%TYPE;

V_HRANUMBER(10,2); V_DA        NUMBER(10,2);
V_MEDICAL CONSTANT NUMBER(10,2) := 500; V_PFNUMBER(10,2);
V_GROSS_SAL NUMBER(10,2);

BEGIN

V_EID := &Enter_Employee_ID;

SELECT EID, ENAME, DEPTNO, DEPTNAME, GENDER, AGE, BASICSAL
INTO V_EID, V_ENAME, V_DEPTNO, V_DEPTNAME, V_GENDER, V_AGE, V_BASICSAL FROM EMP

WHERE EID = V_EID;

V_HRA := V_BASICSAL * 15 / 100; V_DA := V_BASICSAL * 50 / 100; V_PF := V_BASICSAL * 10 / 100;

V_GROSS_SAL := V_BASICSAL + V_HRA + V_DA + V_MEDICAL - V_PF;

DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('========================================='); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('EMPLOYEE SALARY DETAILS'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('========================================='); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Employee ID : ' || V_EID); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Name: ' || V_ENAME); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Department No : ' || V_DEPTNO); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Department Name : ' || V_DEPTNAME); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Gender      : ' || V_GENDER); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Age          : ' || V_AGE);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('-----------------------------------------'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Basic Salary : ' || V_BASICSAL); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('HRA (15%): ' || V_HRA); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('DA (50%)      : ' || V_DA); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Medical       : ' || V_MEDICAL); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('PF (10%)      : ' || V_PF); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('-----------------------------------------'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Gross Salary : ' || V_GROSS_SAL);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('=========================================');

EXCEPTION
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Employee with EID ' || V_EID || ' not found!'); WHEN OTHERS THEN
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Error: ' || SQLERRM);

END; /

DECLARE

PRINCIPAL := &Enter_Principal_Amount;
RATE:= &Enter_Rate_of_Interest_Percentage; YEARS     := &Enter_Number_of_Years;

DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('========================================='); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SIMPLE INTEREST CALCULATOR'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('========================================='); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Principal Amount : '||PRINCIPAL); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Rate of Interest : '||RATE||'%'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Time Period: '||YEARS||' years'); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('          ');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Simple Interest : '||SIMPLE_INTEREST); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Total Amount: '||TOTAL_AMOUNT); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('=========================================');

END; /
